subject: How can I implement a list of lists?

messages.author: 2b2a7dccb793ae6c
messages.subject: How can I implement a list of lists?
parts:
I am new to PyStan.

My data is of the form 

    a=[ a1, a2, a3], 
    where a1=[1,2,3], a2 = [3,5], a3=[3,5,8,2].

I browse the Stan reference but cannot find a suitable data type for it. 
Does anyone know how to do it?

messages.author: f53f4ca2c430170d
messages.subject: Re: How can I implement a list of lists?
parts: Look at the manual section on sparse data formats, it might be referred to as a database format. Krzysztof
